body:
I'd done foxy repeatedly in the doses suggested at the time (6-12 mg). The experences were generaly tense and uninteresting.
My old amd microgram scacle died and recently I injected 30+ mg of foxy.  WOW, great trip lasting ~ 3hrs.  Mosaic paterns on the ceilingl, carpet, pants.   Fun all around, though the initial 'flash ' from IV injection is a little scary.  Have  everything cleaned up before injecting.  And a place to lie down.
